title: Jigsaw Puzzle Epic
description: Relax, enjoy and train your brain with Jigsaw Puzzle Epic, a classic jigsaw puzzle game with more then 2000's of high quality picture puzzles in variety of different collections suitable for both adults and children.

title: Favorite Puzzles
description: Meet Favorite Puzzles, your new favorite jigsaw puzzles! This addictive puzzle game will delight you with an endless gallery of beautiful images for every taste! Favorite Puzzles will be interesting for kids and adult, in this game you can adjust the difficulty and divide the picture from 6 to 600 elements! To make jigsaw puzzles even more enjoyable and easier - you can always get a hint, include an example and display the grid! And you can also create a puzzle from your own pictures or photos!

title: Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire
description: Piece together a paradise in Mojicon Garden Jigsaw Solitaire! Solve beautiful puzzles to restore a dry meadow back to a lush, blooming garden. Enjoy a meditative experience with smooth controls and the iconic Mojicon art style. Can you bring the garden back to life?

title: Dragon Year Jigsaw
description: Dive into the lively universe of 'Dragon Year Jigsaw,' a comical online puzzle game set in the Chinese Dragon Year. Solve 24 levels of dragon-themed jigsaw puzzles, featuring vibrant and playful comic art. Perfect for puzzle lovers and those seeking a whimsical online experience. Join the fun – start piecing together your dragon adventure now!

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.

title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw is a funny puzzle game with the most popular meme characters. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Fix Da Brainrot
description: Fix Da Brainrot is a quirky jigsaw puzzle game with pieces that look like torn paper. Pick your challenge —16 pieces for a quick and easy fix or 32 pieces for a real brain teaser. Drag, drop, and fit the torn pieces together, and watch the picture slowly come alive as you fix the brainrot and conquer the puzzle!

description: Are you a cat lover with a passion for puzzles? If so, get ready for an adorable and engaging adventure with “Cute Cat Jigsaw Puzzle.” This delightful game features 15 levels of feline-themed fun that will captivate your heart and challenge your mind.

title: Springle Puzzle
description: Springle Puzzle is a fun and fast jigsaw game where you solve puzzles before time runs out. Choose from styles like Classic, Irregular, Hexagon, or Wave, each with a different feel. Play easy mode with fewer pieces for a quick game and lower score, or pick more pieces for a harder challenge and higher score. If time runs out, watch a reward ad and keep playing.
